creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Alex, 2026-10-05: the sidebar's MESSAGES list held three finished groups with unread dots (two 1:1 groups with agents long gone, one demo council) and he asked how to close them. The window has no action for it; only `muster msg group delete G`, which also drops the log. For a group kept on a devenv (`demo-council@devenv`), the laptop's CLI refuses ("is kept on devenv ... this machine only holds a copy"), so it had to be deleted with the devenv's muster.

Wanted: a right-click (or swipe) on a group row to close it: at least leave/hide it for the human, with delete as the stronger option, routed to whichever daemon keeps the group. A group whose other members have all gone could also be offered for closing once read.
title: 🗂️ No way to close a message group from the sidebar
